findings: CVE-2026-73622 is a real CWE-200: attacker-controlled URLs to Remote.create()/Repo.create_remote() and Submodule.add() are passed through Git.polish_url() with default expand_vars=True, expanded via os.path.expandvars(), stored in .git/config or .gitmodules, and disclosed on fetch/pull. CVE.org is PUBLISHED; GHSA-9rmj-fh79-gf6w withdrawn_at is null; vendor GHSA-94p4-4cq8-9g67 is published.

The smallest public first-writer of the documented native expandvars transform is 43564d2e8f3b95f33e10a5c8cc2d75c0252d659a, not primary introducer e6e23ed24b35c6154b4ee0da5ae51cd5688e5e67. Parent 2ba39bd0f0b27152de78394d2a37f3f81016d848 only rewrites a leading $HOME/ token.

Direct fix is 863417457a0633db7ea5aed4fd01e0b291a41162 (PR 2181), first released in 3.1.55. 3.1.54 remains affected. 8ac5a30519b6f4af85398b9b9d7064ff4d452da2 is an AI-authored incomplete clone-only fix and is not the BIC.
BIC-only authorship is named human Abhishek Kumar Singh in 2019 with no AI/bot/generator marker, so NOT_AI stands. Primary verdict is correct; primary introducer_sha/parent/origin text are not.

corrected_fields.bug_semantics: An attacker-controlled URL supplied to Repo.create_remote()/Remote.create()/Remote.add() or Submodule.add() is passed through Git.polish_url(). From 43564d2e8f3b95f33e10a5c8cc2d75c0252d659a the native (non-Cygwin) path calls os.path.expandvars(url), substituting process environment secrets into HTTP/scp URLs. The expanded value is written to .git/config or .gitmodules and transmitted on a later fetch/pull. 8ac5a30519b6f4af85398b9b9d7064ff4d452da2 disabled expansion only for clone.
corrected_fields.flaw_origin: The smallest first-writer of the advisory primitive is single-parent commit 43564d2e8f3b95f33e10a5c8cc2d75c0252d659a, which replaced a $HOME-only prefix rewrite in Git.polish_url() with os.path.expandvars(url) while Remote.create and Submodule.add already called polish_url. Immediate parent 2ba39bd0f0b27152de78394d2a37f3f81016d848 lacks arbitrary variable expansion. 2016 Cygwin commit e6e23ed24b35c6154b4ee0da5ae51cd5688e5e67 is not this BIC because cygpath leaves scheme-bearing remote URLs unexpanded.
